goal: Expose a fail-closed Baby2B performance control plane protected by Cloudflare Access independent MFA and backed by fixed BabySteps GitHub Actions.
nonGoals: Device posture as an authorization factor
Custom MFA or WebAuthn implementation inside the Worker
Arbitrary repository, workflow, AWS command, duration, region, or stack inputs
Exposing Access JWTs, GitHub App credentials, callback secrets, or raw operator identity
Changing unrelated Dashboard projects or retired Evidence infrastructure
networkScope: Cloudflare Access and Worker services for baby2b.online
GitHub App installation restricted to Tiancheng-Xu/babysteps Actions dispatch
Public read-only Dashboard status and protected control endpoints
acceptanceCriteria: Public status and snapshot reads remain available without MFA
All control session, start, and stop routes require a verified Cloudflare Access JWT for the exact allowlisted operator
Cloudflare Access independent MFA is the authentication authority; the Worker does not implement custom MFA
Mutations require same-origin requests, a single-use nonce, and an idempotency key
The Worker dispatches only the fixed BabySteps workflow through a repository-scoped GitHub App installation token
D1 records generation, operation, expiry, sanitized actor hash, cost estimate, callback, and cleanup state
R2 stores only validated immutable snapshots and D1 exposes their verified projection
The page shows 45-minute TTL, USD 0.20 cap, truthful pending/running/cleanup-required states, and disables unsafe actions
Evidence records architecture, sequence, auth boundary, recovery, tests, limitations, and sanitized production proof
